item.description:
## Pull requests
- **Work on a pull request:** Attach or check out a GitHub pull request from the sidebar. Open it in a new worktree, in the project folder, or just link it to the chat. Linked pull requests show as badges on their chats, with their state, and the inspector shows their details. - **Agents and pull requests:** Agents can link and unlink pull requests with `link_pull_request` and `unlink_pull_request`, list a chat's pull requests with `list_thread_pull_requests`, and read live details such as the description, mergeability and CI checks with `read_pull_request`. A review can be handed off to another chat.
## Composer
- **@ mentions:** Type **@** in the composer to tag a file in the checkout, another chat, or an open browser tab. `@file:`, `@thread:` and `@tab:` narrow the search. Tags appear as chips you can inspect or remove, show as badges in the sent message, and point the agent at the file path, chat or tab. This works on Mac, iPhone and iPad.
## Usage
- **Antigravity usage:** The Usage window now counts Antigravity's token use. - **Models & Pricing:** Set your own token prices for any model, and link a model's names from different providers into one standardized model so they share a row. Models without a price are listed, with a shortcut to set one.
## iPhone and iPad
- **Larger photos and videos:** Photos and videos up to 100 MB from your Mac's files now preview on iPhone and iPad. Viewed ones are cached on the device until the file changes. - **Diffs:** File diffs use a new viewer, and Antigravity's edits now show diffs per file. - **File links:** Tapping a file citation in a reply opens that file at the cited line.
## Fixed
- File links and citations pointing into worktrees, whose paths contain spaces, now show as links instead of raw Markdown.

## Images and attachments
- **Image galleries:** Images in a reply now sit in wide rows of up to three, and clicking one opens it in its own full-size viewer with zoom and arrow-key paging through that row. On iPhone and iPad, tapping an image opens a full-screen gallery you can swipe through. - **Drag and paste:** Drag images out of the conversation into other apps on Mac, iPhone and iPad, or use **Copy Image** from the context menu. Paste images, files and links straight into the composer; on iPhone, **Paste** is also in the Attach menu. - **Previews:** The attachment card pages through mixed images and files together, and PDF markup applies only to the file you're editing.
## Agents
- **Pi:** Long turns with image attachments no longer fail on oversized messages, sent images no longer show twice, and Pi's code-mode tool runs show as code with their nested tool calls. - **Antigravity:** Turns that start a background command, such as a dev server, now finish instead of hanging, and a stuck cancellation recovers the session instead of locking the chat. - **Factory Droid:** Turns where several tools return images or documents no longer break the session, and errors show the underlying cause. - **Plans:** Each agent's plan now comes from its own checklist tool. OpenCode and Pi, which have none, no longer show a plan.
## Fixed
- A crash when moving the cursor in the composer after its text changed. - Hangs while Usage history imported on the main thread.

## Sleep and wake
- **Your Mac can sleep while you're away:** Hosting Connect no longer keeps the Mac awake on its own. Controller still keeps it awake while agents are working, and for a few minutes while a connected device is using it. - **Sleeping, not offline:** Before your Mac sleeps, it tells your connected iPhone and other Macs, which show **Mac is sleeping** instead of trying to reconnect. Chats you've already opened stay readable while it sleeps. - **Wake Mac:** Choose **Wake** on a sleeping Mac to wake it over your local network. With **Wake Mac automatically when needed** on, sending a message, answering an approval or starting a chat wakes it for you. - **Choose who can wake this Mac:** Connect settings has an **Allow remote wake** option, which you can limit to times the Mac is on power. It also tells you if **Wake for network access** is off in System Settings → Battery, since remote wake needs it.
## Agents
- **OpenCode retries provider failures:** When the model provider fails partway through a turn, OpenCode now retries and picks up where it left off. Errors that end a turn and retry notices now stay visible in the conversation even with background notices hidden. - **Steering Antigravity and Droid:** Sending a new message while Antigravity or Factory Droid is working now redirects it reliably, including when you send several in a row. Tools stopped by steering show as interrupted or cancelled instead of failed.
## Faster conversations
- Scrolling while an agent works is smoother, especially during long runs of tool calls and messages between them. - Expanded reasoning shows the agent's full trace paragraphs, fades in as one continuous sweep, and no longer jumps or overlaps text when you open it.
## Fixed
- Opening the browser panel could crash Controller 1.0.33. This release fixes it.
